# Dated style calibration

These are observations from the research corpus collected in September 2026, not a current prevalence measurement or a blacklist. Consult them when a free style choice seems unexamined; judge the result within the brief and existing system.

Observed clusters included indigo-gradient heroes with rounded feature cards; warm cream, high-contrast serif and terracotta; near-black with an acid accent; broadsheet hairlines; frosted panels; and generic corporate figures. The same look can be an appropriate deliberate choice. A claim that a gradient or typeface is currently overused needs fresh observations, not a newer date on this file.

Use the subject and intended experience to develop the composition. Review the visual idea and its execution, not compliance with a list of forbidden styles. A mandatory exclusion list would merely constrain the next set of defaults.
